service_descriptions.Tree Felling & Dismantling: Safe removal of trees in any location, using modern rigging and dismantling techniques.
service_descriptions.Dangerous Tree Removal: Emergency removal of storm-damaged, diseased or hazardous trees.
service_descriptions.Crown Lifting & Pruning: Raise the canopy for clearance, light and access while maintaining tree health.
service_descriptions.Crown Reduction & Thinning: Reduce size and density of the crown to manage growth and wind resistance.
service_descriptions.Planting & Formative Pruning: Professional tree planting and early-stage pruning for strong structure.
service_descriptions.Stump Grinding: Complete stump removal to ground level or below - ready for replanting or turfing.
service_descriptions.Mobile Sawmilling: On-site milling of your own timber into usable boards and beams.
service_descriptions.Wood Chipping: Supply of wood chip for garden use, mulch or biomass.
service_descriptions.Tree Surveys & Consultancy: Professional tree inspections, reports and management plans using GPS & GIS mapping.
service_descriptions.BS5837 Construction Reports: Trees in relation to construction - surveys and reports for planning applications.
service_descriptions.Tree Hazard Assessment: Identification and risk assessment of potentially dangerous trees.
service_descriptions.NVC & Phase 1 Habitat Surveys: Ecological surveys for development and land management.

about: Alban Tree Care are graduate tree specialists, offering a complete range of tree services from arboriculture and tree surgery to consultancy and surveys. Established in 2005, we have built a solid reputation by offering honest, reliable and professional service covering domestic and commercial work. Our clients range from private homeowners to land agents, estates and the construction industry. We carry out all aspects of tree care and offer 24 hour emergency call out.
